# Open Gate

> We buy houses in the Treasure Valley, as-is, for cash.

Open Gate is the public name of Open Gate Holdings LLC, an Idaho limited liability company. Nick and Jake Gifford, brothers who grew up in the Treasure Valley, buy houses in Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell, Eagle, Kuna, Star, Garden City and Middleton, Idaho.

Nick and Jake have bought and flipped nearly 100 doors since 2004. That is their experience. It is not a claim that Open Gate Holdings LLC completed those deals.

We buy houses as-is, including estate homes, houses that need work, and rentals with tenants in place. Skip the repairs, and leave behind anything you don't want. There is no charge to talk, and you do not have to accept an offer. If we make an offer, it will explain any inspection or other conditions. We buy the house ourselves and close on it. We can close quickly.

Call (208) 361-0198 or email hello@opengateboise.com. Texting is not offered on this number yet.

This is a service-area business. We go to the house. There is no public office address on this site.
